decisions.rationale: A dedicated API with selected-client access requires one narrow owner and must not inherit memory mutation or provider invocation authority.
Selected clients may consult only an approved neutral projection; access permission must not expose private ontology internals.
Anyone selected by the owner receives an individual high-entropy key whose stored form is a hash and whose grant can be disabled or removed.

ownerBindings.security: ResonantOS bridge capability and consultation access-key boundary

implementationBoundary.accessModel: bridge authentication plus route capability plus per-client access key
